storyInfo: The War Casters find the Sarcophagus, but are unable to transport it or put it to use, thus thwarting Evgeny's plans. 'Tulin' reveals her true identity, and she, Koshelna the 'Black Snake,' and Anastasia the 'Princess' all rally their followers in different locations. Scioppa adjusts the ship's heading and prepares to attack Evgeny's flagship.

attributes.content: Slowly, the life pod opens.
There, you see a familiar face, just as you have hoped to see thousands of times.
Once again, you take her hand.
Dr. {@nickname}?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Slowly, the woman inside gets up.
Dr. Kal'tsit! / Kal'tsit!
attributes.name: Amiya/Mon3tr

attributes.content: Kal'tsit...
attributes.name: Raidian
Closure
attributes.content: I did it?

attributes.name: Closure
attributes.content: Woohoo, I did it!
Kal'tsit, is that you? Do you recognize me? If not, you gotta at least recognize the Doctor and Amiya, right?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Amiya suppresses the urge to dash forward to embrace Kal'tsit, as Mon3tr digs her sharp claws deep into the soil beneath. Each and every one of them looks on nervously, as not one of them can so easily believe this outcome.
In contrast, the woman who has just been roused from her slumber looks to each member of the group gathered around her. Slowly, her bewildered expression begins to soften.
Somebody tell me... Why am I here?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: It's all thanks to the Doctor—and Closure, too!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: We've been racking our brains to recreate the gemini cycle function and use blank Originium to sculpt a body for you!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: The experiments haven't been going well, but somehow, we managed to find AMa-10's source code in the Sarcophagus in Ursus—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: That's practically impossible, in theory...
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Doesn't matter!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Well... Are you feeling okay? Are your memories all jumbled? And, um—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Do you still remember me?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: How could I ever forget you...?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Mon3tr...
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: I really missed you...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Watch out, Mon3tr! Dr. Kal'tsit may still be very weak!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Thank you, Amiya...
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Don't worry... I can tell... my condition isn't particularly serious.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: What I really want to know is... where are we, and what is the current situation?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: (Pants weakly)
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: You don't need to be in such a hurry to figure out what's going on.;Don't push yourself. We still have time.
I don't want you to worry...
All's well at Rhodes Island.;Everyone is here.

attributes.content: Dr. {@nickname}...
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: I must say... I really do not agree with how you led Rhodes Island... on such a dangerous operation.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: We need you to come back to fight alongside us.;Amiya and I arrived at this decision together.

attributes.content: Dr. {@nickname}, I've never doubted your decisions for a long time. However...
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: I'm afraid I'll have to reevaluate your decision-making now.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: I'll get your whole critique once we're back at Rhodes Island.
Naturally, I had other reasons too.

attributes.content: For example?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: Have you found yourself yet... Kal'tsit?

attributes.content: ...I never forgot.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: I hear fighting... I suppose Ursus's many factions are still vying for the Sarcophagus?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: This does indeed have to do with the Sarcophagus.;The situation is a little more complicated than that.
We should get ready to pull out.

attributes.content: Doctor, I need to know... where is the Sarcophagus?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: I still have... unfinished business.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: <p=1>Zelgrad Sealed District Laboratory</><p=2> Jan 22, 1102, 18:53</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: After stopping in front of the bloody palm print on the door for a brief moment, the man starts to slowly walk out of the dark corridor.
The only energy pipeline from the satellite city has begun to operate once more. He has fulfilled his promise.
Nothing following that is of any importance to him.
Alita...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: The man slowly falls to his knees and picks up one of the countless ice-cold bodies on the floor.
Had you long since given up the ideals that you talked about as a girl, when you fed fowlbeasts by the pond, would you really have ended up like this?
I never had the courage to tell you... I'd actually completely forgotten the promises I made before the statues of our forebears... those lies I told for the empire's sake.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: And I've never really cared about their so-called 'better tomorrow.'
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: All I know is that, when a soldier leaves home, his family is always there to send him off, yet when we left Chernobog, the entire city was still asleep.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: For so many days and nights, all I've wanted is to go back to Lada's bedside.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: But I had to keep an eye on you, too.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: I have to look after you... so you won't be alone... chasing things and hurting yourself in the process.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Hah...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Klim Valuev... In the end...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: You still managed to accomplish nothing.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: All clear...
attributes.name: Indistinct Voice

attributes.content: The bodies...
attributes.name: Indistinct Voice

attributes.content: Found a survivor.
Who are you people?
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Never mind. Doesn't matter.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: If you're here for the Sarcophagus. It's right behind me.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: If that's not what you are after...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Then get out. Now.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Assessment complete.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: The Sarcophagus weaponization module has been completely destroyed. Only its energy transformation stabilizer module remains, with an external channel still operational.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: The Sarcophagus's core structure is massive and complex. It is nigh impossible to neatly dismantle for transportation with such little time. Please advise.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: Right, it's irreparable. It cannot be done, even with all of us deploying the strongest evocation-conversion Arts at once.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: The weaponization module's damage appears to have been caused by some sort of even greater power.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: Furthermore, based on observations prior to entry, the plate housing the Sarcophagus has suffered continual external attack. We can surmise that the First Army has already abandoned Zelgrad.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: Acknowledged.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: We'll pull out immediately.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: From afar, the soldiers, having just received their orders, look upon the sole survivor.
The sound of explosions outside is drawing ever closer, yet it seems he is making no effort to escape at all.
Why waste time on a man who will not live?
Hm...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: This is the last time. Forgive my cowardice, Alita.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: After all... you've always been the bravest of us.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Even the Second Army... Even the Second Army has turned against me, Witte!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: What are we waiting for? For the traitors to march into Grypherburg and Tsarevgrad—for them to breach the palace and impale me on the throne?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty... You must know why the Second Army resorted to such means.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: The Winter Emergency Resource Allocation Act.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: They think this bill will inevitably hurt their interests, perhaps even the Army's authority independent of the legislature. That's why they chose to turn a blind eye to the Fourth Army's actions.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: No... Even suppose they had a problem with that, they wouldn't have gone against the edict like this... Someone must be fanning the flames!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Is it her... or who else would it be? My dear aunt...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Majesty... All things considered, our top priority should be the crisis at hand.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: That said, each day that this bill isn't passed is another day that the Second Army doesn't point their spears directly to Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Therefore, strictly speaking, they have yet to form any kind of coalition of mutual interest, and we still have a chance to negotiate with the Second Army.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Moreover—
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Witte, Witte! Listen to yourself. What nonsense are you talking?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Even a traitor like Saveliy knows that the Second Army's decision to stand on the sidelines is tantamount to rebellion against us, and you're still making excuses for them.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: If I didn't know you and trust you, such words would be enough to brand you a traitor like the rest of them!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: If such thinking calms your nerves, then fine, but I also know that you are no tyrant. You want to solve real problems, not emotional ones.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Which is why, no matter how furious you may be, you still have that basic level of sanity. You are not like those wild beasts.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What will you do, Witte? Will you really accede to their demands and postpone the citizen's forum indefinitely?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: No, Majesty, I won't. The final deadline that we gave them is tomorrow's citizen's forum.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Why?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: If, before the citizen's forum is called, we fail to cut a deal with the Second Army, make no progress on the Sarcophagus's energy, and the Grand Duchess doesn't change her position...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Then we will have no choice but to mobilize the Central Army and stop all these sides from coming to blows, and at the same time put a stop to all this sedition once and for all... There will be no mercy or patience.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Even if none of us know whether the empire can still withstand a civil war of such scale.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Within the fire burns the final urgent letter from the south.
Before the flames can reach her fingertips, Elisaveta lets go of the letter and pulls back her hand.
So the Second Army chose to stand on the sidelines too?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Although this development is hardly unexpected.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Hm...
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: It's just that the Chairman may have to play his very last card.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: My merciful, fledgling, and pitiful liege... Within you flows the blood of the old Tsar, yet unlike your father, you are not fit to be autocrat of all the Ursines.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Nor is there an advisor at your side, as capable as the late Empress was.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: If all you're doing is pushing things through, how long can you possibly last?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: It's a good thing, then, that an individual more suited to the job has returned...
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Her gaze turns to a woman looking at a painting on the wall.
Her features are practically the same as those of a woman in the portrait.
Auntie.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Is this... a painting of me?
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: No, my love. That is your mother. Your father, too.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: It seems I have forgotten their smiles.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: It's a cruel side effect that sometimes comes with the pains of life, not to mention that you've been through far too much these past few years.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: But I must remember.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: You will. I will help you... I will always help you, and stand by your side.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Ever since you were a child, you have been strong and unwilling to concede defeat. You are far too much like your father.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: My father... What was he like?
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: A ruler with excellent foresight, ambition, gallantry. He poured his heart and soul into revitalizing Ursus's territorial expansion and feeding his citizens, never resting even a moment until his death.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: One could say that he was the greatest man to ever grace Ursus, second only to Igor Velikiy, who forged this empire.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: He sounds very... distant.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Right, he was extraordinarily hard to get close to. Only your mother ever dared to stand near him.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Really? That sounds very lonely.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: ...I doubt he ever felt that way, other than when your mother passed—
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Auntie, what's wrong?
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Let's talk about something else, Nastya.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Do you want to go back to Grypherburg?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Grypherburg...
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: A hesitant expression, one that Elisaveta is all too familiar with, appears on Anastasia's face. After a brief moment, she speaks her will.
I want to see Fedya.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Fyodor, my little brother.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: I want to see him.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: If I must return to Grypherburg to see him, then I wish to go back.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: If he is not there, then I will go to where he is.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: No matter where he is?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Yes, no matter where he is.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: And why do you wish to see him?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Must I have a special reason? I think he probably wants to see me, too.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: If that is the case, Anastasia, then you must know a certain truth first.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: I am listening.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: While you were missing... no, wandering all over Ursus, Fyodor succeeded your father and tried his best to be a good Tsar.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Unfortunately, he is simply no good at it, and the job is not a good fit for him either.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: If memory serves, he loves reading, and he even wrote his own poems. Does he still do that?
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: His role as the Tsar has no doubt consumed a significant majority of his time. Even if he still does write, it is most likely satirical poems written to vent his anger.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: That is just conjecture, though.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: It has been a very long time since he spoke to me. Even his letters are penned by others on his behalf.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: It seems that he hasn't changed at all... He worries about how others see him, too much for his own good.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: My poor Fedya. I can practically imagine how hard he pushes himself to become an unbiased—even ruthless—symbol... because that is what the people want.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: But he should never show that facade to you, of all people. After all, you are the only family we have, and we used to be so close... Right?
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: That was a long time ago.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: There have since been certain things that I handled in a less than satisfactory way, even if it was all out of concern for him. The saddest thing is that we share the same name and should be helping one another.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Instead, he trusted an outsider, and one from the bottom rung of society with no foresight, to the point that he dragged all of Ursus into a terrible mess.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Now, this great land faces a hopeless future because of his reckless actions.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: If he would turn away a loyal family member and subject like myself at this perilous juncture... then how many do you think still stand by his side?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: ...I understand now.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: What do you want me to do?
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Save him, and save Ursus, my dear Nastya.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: You are the only one. Only you can do this.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Because... within you flows his blood.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: I should never have doubted your loyalty, my dear Witte.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: But if worse comes to worst, as you said, then you'll have to forgive my stubbornness, as I will have to take to the front lines.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: My most loyal men will be fighting for me, and with the Second Army turning against me, that is the most effective way to rouse my people.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty!
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Trust me, Witte. After all, I'm not like those weak tin soldiers in the fortress. I am—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The Emperor and Autocrat of All the Ursines.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Highness, we have news from the Deity Grypherburg Power Dispatch Center.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: What have they discovered?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: They say that the high-voltage fencing's isolated failure points have been restored. Once the transformer is in place, we will be able to use the node to restore power to some of the affected areas.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: Which line did the failures originate in?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: The lines connected to the newly built energy pipeline. That said, the power facilities are old.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: They were originally intended for use only while the city was stationary, but the lines failed not too long ago, so we temporarily isolated the failure points for investigation. They have been restored now.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: Thank you. You are excused.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: It's better than nothing, but can this tiny bit of energy really feed the entire empire?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: No... This is a sign, Majesty.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: One that tells us the worst is yet to come.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Shh. She's asleep. Please, try not to wake her...
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: (In Sami) So, you got yourself involved.
I know what I am getting myself into.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: (In Sami) Says everyone who is willingly deceived.
(In Sami) Despite appearances, its heart is completely empty. Everything you hear and see is a mere projection of your desires.
If you are really worried, then stay here and help me.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Use your Shaman eyes to help me see through this darkness.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: (In Sami) No, that is not part of our deal.
(In Sami) The ritual is complete. I shall take my leave.
(In Sami) Before your vulgar and stupid desires backfire on you, do not forget to fulfill your end of the bargain.
Main forces... retreating...
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: This is your final order... Eliminate... Infected creatures—
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: Acknowledged.
attributes.name: Ursine Soldier

attributes.content: Staying behind to clean up again...
attributes.name: Ursine Soldier

attributes.content: The soldier tosses his communicator to the side and takes a swig of vodka.
This morning, while he was kneading dough in the field kitchen, he found himself dragged outside by his officer.
This wasn't his first time using Originium bolts, but it was his first time taking a life, even if it was a mutated animal.
Before he left, he stuffed all the spirits he had into his backpack. Ever since, every time he's fired a bolt, he's taken a swig. It is the only way to keep his fingers from shaking.
A cloudbeast, or perhaps something that resembled a cloudbeast.
He thinks back to how the fluffy little things would hop into the kitchen and tug on his pants with their claws, and he would tear off a chunk of bread in exchange for a chance to pat their heads.
Sorry, old friend...
attributes.name: Ursine Soldier

attributes.content: He approaches the creature lying on the ground unsteadily and reaches his right hand out—
Suddenly, the creature violently bounces up and turns into a black shadow. It leaps toward the soldier, causing him to shriek and raise his arms instinctively.
Blyat! How many times have I told you?! Hold your weapon upright, get a bead on your target, then fire!
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: Once I'm done with these ublyudki, I'll drown you in your vodka!
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: Right after he reprimands his subordinate, despite the bolt pierced through its body, the mutated creature shrieks and leaps up again.
Before the two are able to react, a scorching hot wave blasts past them. The beast is incinerated, turned to ash, while the pavement beneath it melts into a charred black pit.
Wait! You're—
attributes.name: Ursine Soldier

attributes.content: Slow down, Private. Lower your weapon. Stand aside and stay alert. I will handle her.
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: He shouldn't stay here. Neither should you.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: These creatures are crawling all over this city. No one should be here.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: That is not for you to decide, Reunion. My commanding officer says the area is abandoned, but I have not received orders to move out.
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: And so, I cannot allow these crazed creatures to flee Zelgrad. They would go southwest and spread their disease to the people there.
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: Somebody has to stay... A few hundred lives for thousands more. It's a fair price to pay.
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: I've seen many soldiers lay down their arms during confrontation with Reunion, letting civilians leave in peace.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Were those your orders, too?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: No, they were decisions we made on the spot. You won... temporarily, at least.
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: The First Army has had losses before, but even the greenest of our soldiers stood steadfast in the face of Gaulish artillery. They waited where they stood with their stump legs for the Tsar's reinforcements.
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: Zelgrad belongs to the First Army... From now on, whenever Ursine citizens bring up the city, it will be known as the front line of the empire's glory, where all the monsters were quelled.
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: Which is why, if you aren't here to kill us, I ask you to let us fulfill our duty as Ursine soldiers.
attributes.name: Ursine Officer

attributes.content: The woman nods, and the old officer lowers his guard. He signals to the soldier standing nearby and walks away with him in silence.
Hmm...
attributes.name: Elegant Voice

attributes.content: You're still easily swayed by noble-sounding speeches. Perhaps that will always be your flaw, my dear...
attributes.name: Elegant Voice

attributes.content: You—!
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: She unsheathes her blade the moment she hears that familiar voice.
But when she turns, she finds not that familiar individual, but the ruined streets.
The main forces have retreated.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Lyudmila, our Reunion friends are still fighting the army in the city. I can bring a few men with me to help.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Let's just leave this to them. This kind of back alley brawl is exactly Reunion's forte. Besides, you've seen how intense the battles can get in the city.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I'm not trying to sell you short... Anyone who can still hold a blade should stay to protect their friends.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Now that I've had a front-row seat to Reunion's combat style, I must say it's really quite remarkable.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: ...I haven't been one of them for a while now.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: But just to be safe, I'll be heading back to check on things and fill Red in on your situation over here.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Right. For safety's sake, I'll take everyone deeper into the forest. We'll meet up at the western boundary of the forest.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Sounds good to me.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: But before that...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I need to know who you really are.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Sure enough...
attributes.name: 'Tulin'

attributes.content: Ivan Tulin was an incredible warrior. If someone is taking his name, I need to know why.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Isn't that exactly why?
attributes.name: 'Tulin'

attributes.content: Ivan Tulin. This name is like a banner in the Northern Tundra. I don't want this name to disappear from the public consciousness.
attributes.name: 'Tulin'

attributes.content: You mean he's—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: It was maybe three years ago. In the end, he wasn't able to escape the Patrol Units' manhunt.
attributes.name: 'Tulin'

attributes.content: I know I'm not the only person to have learned and received help from him, and I may not be the one most deserving of taking up his name. I just believe that somebody has to do it.
attributes.name: 'Tulin'

attributes.content: I couldn't afford to wait for somebody to step up to the task, so I did.
attributes.name: 'Tulin'

attributes.content: Perhaps Talulah will be disappointed once she learns the truth... but I believe you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Could you at least tell me your real identity, your actual name?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: ...Milana.
attributes.name: 'Tulin'

attributes.content: A normal miner, the daughter of peasants.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: All my miner brothers and sisters know this, but they prefer to call me Tulin, out of habit.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: But it'd make me very happy to have a good friend willing to call me Milana.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Alright, Milana—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: With a hint of remorse, Milana nods to Crownslayer, bidding her farewell.
Then, she slowly walks toward the source of the sobbing—a young girl, and some broken parts scattered across the ground.
Come on, Yana, don't cry. I'll help you look. We'll put it back together.
attributes.name: Ursine Boy

attributes.content: No... *sob*... We can't do it. Only Papa knows how.
attributes.name: Ursine Girl

attributes.content: Um, did something happen here?
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: *sigh* This young lady here fell and broke her pocket watch.
attributes.name: Ursine Worker

attributes.content: Her father... Li'l Letov, was the best watchmaker in town. He died this morning under a collapsed beam in their house. It's what he left her.
attributes.name: Ursine Worker

attributes.content: The young woman nods and drops to her knees to get on the same level as the little girl. She reaches her right hand out, and dusts off the girl's dirty clothes.
Yana, right? Can I call you Yanushka?
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: ...Mhm.
attributes.name: Ursine Girl

attributes.content: I remember you. You were so brave during the evacuation. You aren't crying just because of the broken watch, right?
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Papa... died. Our home... is gone.
attributes.name: Ursine Girl

attributes.content: I don't know... where we can go...
attributes.name: Ursine Girl

attributes.content: Perhaps none of us know...
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: But we need to keep walking until we find our new home.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: ...Go back, Milana. Your leg hasn't completely healed. This is far enough.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: Leithanien is very far, Tulin. I don't know if this might be the last time we see each other.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Maybe it will be... but that place is free of the Ursine military police. I will be able to study and create in peace again, for a while.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: Yes, I hear they have towering spires, taller than even the clouds. And their magic and music can bring warmth to even the coldest nights.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: But I don't need warmth. I need to find that spark of fire for the people.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: I can feel Ursus's harsh cold, but I don't know how to strike at its source... Just like my brother... I can only go to see more, and see for myself all the suffering faces across the lands.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: To me, Leithanien isn't a punishment. I will tear up all those arrogant scriptures, and turn even their most complicated spells into language that the workers can understand, to bring an end to this cold once and for all.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: A language that even I can understand?
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Haha, you're right... Milana, as a friend, I have one earnest request.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: After I'm gone, I want to entrust everyone here—all the miners coughing up blood in the mines, and all the children looking for bread in the snow fields, I entrust them to you.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: ...Tulin, are you kidding me? I'm not like you. I'm an ordinary woman.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: No, I'm an ordinary man myself. Every great person out there is actually as ordinary as can be.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: Greatness isn't a gift you are born with. It's simply the hope that numerous ordinary folk have placed in those who are willing to carry a burden.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: He reaches his right hand out to Milana.
Promise me, Milana. Whether I come back with glory... or send back a broken, blood-soaked chapter... you must live.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: Look after them in my place. Don't let them simply bear with the pain. Let them grow roots in the pain.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: Tulin... Will I... ever see you again?
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: As long as I'm still alive, I will do whatever I can to write back.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: But the moment we must part ways has come.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: Goodbye, my dear friend...
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: If we will never see dawn again, then light up each and every cold night in your own way.
attributes.name: Ivan Tulin

attributes.content: A lot of times, the roads that we walk are slippery and full of potholes. Even the most incredible men are bound to stumble and fall.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: That's not our fault. The fault lies with the place where we run and stand.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: It's just like how your papa could fix all kinds of pocket watches, but if a watch's shell was bent, then your papa wouldn't be able to fix it, no matter how much he polished its parts.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: All we can do is find a new shell and fit it with parts and make it better than the original. Your papa would be so proud, if you managed to do that.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Milana finishes and lifts her head to find the workers slowly gathering around her and the two children.
All of them are listening intently, with some of them fighting back tears.
Yanushka, everyone... Today, you have no choice but to leave your homes—
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Help... Just what is going on?
attributes.name: Helpless Civilian

attributes.content: There are bombs falling from the sky, and the whole town is crawling with monsters—
attributes.name: Helpless Civilian

attributes.content: Why... What happened to the army? Have they given up on this place, on protecting us?
attributes.name: Helpless Civilian

attributes.content: Bozhe moi... We've been abandoned again...
attributes.name: Helpless Civilian

attributes.content: Why wait for anyone to save us?
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: Why do you always need to rely on others for protection? Why must you keep indulging in the city's false spring?
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: Don't you have the same strength as those high and mighty men with big names?
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: Standing atop ruins of the recent past, the white-haired Liberi peers down—Those who are unwilling to leave their homes are gathered in front of her, listening to her speech.
Among them are workers, soldiers, the elderly, and children... Faces you see in just about every city in Ursus. They are confused. They are strong.
Friends of Zelgrad. You have my praise for your resilience and my compliments for your bravery.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: But, esteemed friends, do you know which words the empire uses to describe you? 'Restrained,' 'kind,' 'obedient.' Yes...
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: They kissed you on your foreheads and branded them with the words 'restrained.'
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: They drained your blood and poured 'kindness' into your veins.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: They inflicted your bodies and souls with weariness to make you 'obedient' and easy to bend to their will.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: Under the banner of equality, they bestowed upon you equal destitution. And with hatred and envy, they traded for your love of life and courage in the face of fate.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: More importantly, they sealed your lips and made you ashamed to speak that sacred word—strength.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: Yes, 'strength.' Something that should be abundant in your lives.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: For they know that once you think you have strength, you will crush their extravagant palaces and smash their authority.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: People of Ursus, you can do this—
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: ...If you want me to do this, Auntie, then I will.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: I will make them believe, and my voice will reach them... throughout Ursus, and to Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Yes, dear Nastya. Watch them. They are waiting for you.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: The noble princess nods slightly and begins walking down the stairs to the starving men gathered below.

The men are haggard and weary. They are starved to the point that they can't even lift their heads, and their hunched backs appear slight in the darkness. Right now, there is only one thing on their minds—
'Yurodstvo.'
Once, they willingly endured, but now they have desire. Yet before any of them can voice their wishes, a peaceful, unquestionable voice rings out.
My suffering brothers and sisters, people of Ursus... I have returned.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: The voice sounds the same to every one of its listeners, as though it is capable of cleansing the lands of all injustice and bringing salvation to all suffering.
I see your tears have run dry, yet you still cry out for mercy.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: I see your bodies are covered with scars, yet you still crawl forward in the mud.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Until this day, when you finally look upon me—the Grand Princess of Ursus.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: And I shall declare to you the meaning of patience.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: All of a sudden, there are bread, cheese, and cured meat... as if they have fallen from the sky.

Everyone in attendance forces themselves to lift their heads and reach their hands out. Though they are battered and bruised, not a single voice carries resentment. The only thing that can be heard is thunderous applause: 'Long live the Princess.'
Each of them clasps their hands for the Yurodstvo.
The Grand Duchess looks to the top of her castle and nods.
Children of Ursus, hear me...
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: I see your teary eyes—
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: There is no need to wail simply because your wounds are torn asunder. It will wash away the dust coating your souls.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Do not curse the arrival of your suffering. It will open the door to eternity for you.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Your suffering will from now on be your sustenance. It will bring you boundless strength.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: Use this strength to repay those who took joy in your suffering.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: There will come a day when we deserve these hardships we suffer, which we will use to measure the weight of our lives.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: But we will never sing the praises of our suffering. We willingly let our suffering fade away, because no one should be born to suffer.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: All of us will die, but if you will allow me, I guarantee to all of you a brief, transient happiness while you yet walk among the living.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Everything will take a turn for the better. Everything will be etched into your flesh and blood. Each bloody trail you leave in the snow is a red carpet that leads directly to our holy dominion.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Do you hear that? Your souls are calling out to you. They are screaming, thirsting for pillage and conquest.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: We will endure no longer. Every show of tolerance is an act of suicide. After all, the only thing that stands eternal above this field of permafrost is the truth that strength reigns supreme.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: Now come with me. We will be the vanguard that opens the way.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: As long as we cut open a small crack on the surface of the ice, the surging waters within will wash away our shackles.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: The bread that fills our stomachs is but an insignificant manifestation of power.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: I will make Ursus spread her arms wide. The empire's embrace will be a place where tears are no longer shed.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: The future that I see has no golden idols or noble masters. Only the strong will walk side-by-side.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: Now go. You are the thunderclaps of this storm. Let our will bring order to Ursus!
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: Once these seeds break through the snow, the wilderness will be white no longer. This is a future where we won't need to be given bread, a future where we all work the fields for one another.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: We will no longer be lonely seeds, but field upon field of golden wheat. That day will surely come, just as the sun will rise tomorrow—
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Come, Ursines. Follow in the footsteps of your forebears.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: In my eyes, you already stand...
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: ...in the kingdom of heaven.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: <p=1>Assault Ship Volnov, Command Center</><p=2> Jan 22, 1102, 21:44</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Alright, Oleg is gone too. Ship's all clear!
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Operation manual, control panel...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Gah, what a pain.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Let's see...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: ...Looks like there's a reason why this big girl needs a crew of eight just to keep her trudging along.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: But that's just fine. If it's a suicide mission, we don't need a full complement.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: As long as we tune the presets right—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Command, right? Any further instructions?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: ...back...
attributes.name: Intermittent Voice

attributes.content: Oh, I almost forgot. We've been coasting along for some time since we entered stealth mode. Soon, we'll be out of maximum comms range.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: If we can't hear each other, then I'll hang up.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: In position...
attributes.name: Intermittent Voice

attributes.content: ...Sechin, all units...
attributes.name: Intermittent Voice

attributes.content: I can't make that out. You want all Sechin units to report back? That's easy. I'll be right there.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: ...Razin—
attributes.name: Intermittent Voice

attributes.content: Is that 'all units?' Can't say for sure.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: But we can at least return the Volnov in one piece. That's bringing everything to a proper conclusion.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: The young man follows the figures in the operation manual and adjusts the buttons and knobs on the control panel one-by-one, taking momentary pauses to observe the corresponding readings.
Once everything is ready and confirmed, he lifts the protective cover and presses the button underneath to lock down on the driving mode.
Ship's log, record. January 22, 1102. The Volnov will turn around in an empty field and sail full speed ahead.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Our objective: The flagship of the Fourth Army's main fleet.
attributes.name: Scioppa
